resources.string: For a mail server of your own. Its settings are read only from your domain: its SRV records, then its usual host names (mail., imap., smtp.). Your address is not sent to Mozilla, Microsoft or any other directory. An untrusted certificate is shown for you to check before anything is saved.
Anonymous mail with Postman over the I2P network. FairEmail runs its own I2P router on this device: nothing else to install or set up. The first start can take a few minutes.
From the internet, mail reaches you at NAME@i2pmail.org. At most 20 mails a day can be sent.
Mailbox created. Postman activates it within 5 minutes, then mail arrives.
